about: One agent writes two sentences about autumn leaves and then judges its own draft against the criteria: correct, two sentences, no jargon.
how: There is only one agent: the same model writes, then plays the evaluator, then rewrites.
learns: Self-critique saves a second agent, but it can still find real faults: here it catches the jargon words in the first draft.
watch: The verdict in round 1 (revise, because of chlorophyll and photosynthesis) and the plainer second draft.
